hookups.source: No operator page describes the RV sites: the City of Washington's site (www.wga.gov) has no Callaway or camping page, and the chamber's 2025 post says only 'Picnic area and RV Campsites are available on site' (read 2026-10-29). The stored water/sewer were derived from note prose resting on directory listings (Campendium/RV Life/AllStays), so they are cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the pull-through value rests only on directory listings; no operator page states it (read 2026-10-29).

facilities.source: Same as hookups: 'Free WiFi' rests only on directory listings; no operator page states it (read 2026-10-29).

note: Operated by the City of Washington, GA (Callaway Historic Site, a 56-acre city-owned open-air museum at 2160 Lexington Rd) — ownership local. Directory listings (not the city) describe a handful of full-hookup RV sites in a wooded area behind the plantation; the city publishes no camping page or rate. --Claude
summary: The city publishes nothing about the campground: www.wga.gov (where cityofwashingtonga.gov now lands) has no Callaway or RV page, and no booking method or rate exists from the city. The Washington-Wilkes Chamber's visitor blog of 2025-05-08 still says 'Picnic area and RV Campsites are available on site... For more information call 706-678-7060' (phone matches). Google: Callaway Historic Site, 4.7 / 166 reviews, 706-678-7060, no website. Rates found only on Campendium ($25, reported 2021) - not usable. Cleared directory-only water/sewer/pull-through/WiFi; note trimmed of the undated '~$35/night', site counts and WiFi.
flags: No operator page and no 2024+ rate or booking method: the City of Washington's website (www.wga.gov; cityofwashingtonga.gov redirects there) has no page for Callaway or its RV sites; the only 2024+ evidence that camping is still offered is the chamber's 2025-05-08 visitor blog ('Picnic area and RV Campsites are available on site'). Confirm by phone (706-678-7060) that public nightly RV camping continues and at what rate. Note '~$35/night' was undated and dropped; Campendium's last reported rate is $25 (2021).

Website is a chamber-of-commerce member listing (https://www.washingtonwilkes.org/list/member/callaway-historic-site-284), not the operator's; the city has no page to replace it with. The chamber's 2025 post (https://www.washingtonwilkes.org/blog/visitor-blog-5328/post/history-comes-alive-at-callaway-historic-site-in-washington-ga-40958) is the only page that mentions the RV campsites. Inclusion evidence cites Campendium/RV Life only.
